subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: May MemoryPluginPublicArtifact change from a path-backed artifact contract to an inline virtual-artifact contract, or must existing consumers retain a readable absolutePath?
rationale: This is a shipped plugin-facing API semantic change: optional content fields do not protect existing consumers that dereference absolutePath, so the permanent compatibility direction requires owner intent.

options.title: Preserve path compatibility
options.body: Keep absolutePath readable and introduce a separate discriminated inline-artifact variant with an explicit migration and deprecation path.

options.title: Version virtual artifacts
options.body: Approve virtual artifacts as a new SDK contract, document the changed semantics, update known consumers, and add compatibility tests for older path-only consumers.

recommendation.title: Preserve path compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep absolutePath readable and introduce a separate discriminated inline-artifact variant with an explicit migration and deprecation path.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available ownership trail is the adjacent merged SQLite storage and migration work that established the database boundaries this PR extends.
